title: Arcade Worker
description: Schema for an Arcade worker. Workers host one or more toolkits and are called by the Arcade Engine to execute tool invocations. Workers can be Arcade-hosted or self-hosted via HTTP behind a shared secret.

id.description: Stable worker identifier within the organization (e.g., company-tools).

enabled.description: Whether the worker is currently routable.

http.description: HTTP transport configuration for self-hosted workers.

uri.description: Base URI the Arcade Engine calls.

secret.description: Shared secret used to authenticate Engine -> Worker calls.

retry.description: Number of retries on transient failure.

mcp.description: Configuration when the worker is an MCP server rather than an Arcade HTTP worker.

health.description: Most recent health status reported by the worker.
